name: DeathByFire
source:
The fire ten years ago took away all your memories of him. When he came back to you, did you remember him? In other words, are you still the same people?

Arson doesn't care. All he knew was that he wanted to keep you, with everything he had.

Death by fire means born of fire.

[from [url=https://doze-233.itch.io/deathbyfire]itch.io[/url]]
